sources.own_paraphrase: Some suffixes keep one conventional spelling despite several pronunciations. The page illustrates eight modern past-tense allomorphs with one Ottoman spelling, and four locative allomorphs with one spelling. Its locative examples include elde and avuçta. This documents a writing convention, not its date around1400, an unchanging-stem encoder or automatic unique reading of an unfamiliar script.

This is genre/period background only: it does not bind the modern teaching-page convention to a particular1400hand or identify the Voynich source.
